content_of_post_to_comment: Does anyone else on here recoil when seeing the failure to say “fewer” rather than “less” when the noun is a countable or discrete plural, rather than a continuous quantity, e.g. “fewer apples” versus “less water” or “fewer rocks” versus “less gravel”? I will die on this hill.
comment: The interesting part is that grammar rules often preserve distinctions that everyday speech finds unnecessary. I wonder whether “less” replacing “fewer” reflects a natural simplification of language rather than just an error.
